messages.text: During a Tandem party{when}, {name} advertised a business to the people in the voice room. Tandem's Language Parties Guidelines do not allow promoting or selling anything unless you are an official Tandem partner. This turns a space for learners into advertising. Please review this account and take appropriate action.

{name} tried to sell a service in a live audio room{when}. Unless this user is an official Tandem partner, that is not allowed in Language Parties. Learners join to practise a language, not to be advertised to. Please remove this promotion and remind the account of the rules.

I am reporting {name} for promoting their business in a language party{when}. Promoting or selling anything is not permitted for non-partners under Tandem's Language Parties Guidelines, and it misuses the community for commercial purposes. I would be grateful if you could review the account.

Please review {name}, who advertised a product during a Tandem party{when}. Tandem's Language Parties Guidelines reserve promotion and sales for official Tandem partners. A language room should not become a shop window for the learners in it. I would appreciate a check on whether this account is a partner, and a reminder of the rules if not.

This report concerns commercial promotion in a Tandem voice room{when}. {name} presented their own business to the other learners, which is not allowed in Language Parties unless the user is an official Tandem partner. It turns a practice session into advertising. A reminder of the rules for this account would be welcome.

A participant named {name} promoted a paid service while in a Tandem party{when}. Selling or advertising anything is against the Language Parties Guidelines for anyone who is not an official partner of Tandem, and it uses the community for commercial gain. Please warn this user and remove the promotion if appropriate.

In a language party{when}, {name} promoted their own business. Tandem's Language Parties Guidelines state that nobody may promote or sell anything unless they are an official Tandem partner, and doing so turns the room into advertising for the other learners. Please check the account and, if appropriate, issue a warning.

Tandem's guidelines are clear: unless you are an official partner, you may not promote or sell anything in Language Parties. {name} did exactly that in a live audio room{when}, pitching a product to the learners present. This is commercial use of a language community. Please review the account.

{name} used a Tandem party{when} to promote a company's services rather than to practise a language. Promoting or selling is not allowed in Language Parties unless the user is an official Tandem partner, and it distracts the room from learning. Please remove the promotion and warn the account if appropriate.

Could you please look into {name}? During a voice room on Tandem{when}, this user tried to sell products to the learners. Selling is not allowed in Language Parties for non-partners, and it makes the room feel like a marketplace rather than a place to learn. A reminder of the guidelines to this user would be welcome.

Commercial promotion took place in a Tandem party{when}: {name} advertised their own business to the room. Tandem's Language Parties Guidelines prohibit promoting or selling anything unless the person is an official Tandem partner. It misuses a learning space for marketing. I ask you to review this account.

While I was in a Tandem party{when}, {name} offered a service for sale to the other speakers and listeners. That is not permitted in Language Parties unless this user is an official Tandem partner, and it turns the conversation into a sales pitch. Please remove this promotion and take suitable action.

{name} treated a live audio room{when} as an advertising opportunity and promoted a business there. Under Tandem's Language Parties Guidelines, only official partners may promote or sell anything. Other learners came to practise languages, not to hear a sales pitch. Please review the account and act as appropriate.

Reporting {name} for business promotion in a Tandem party{when}. Please remove the promotion made by {name} in a Tandem voice room{when}.
